project.name: Pristy Search Subsystem - solr9
project.description: Resources-only JAR installed into the Alfresco Repository webapp (WEB-INF/lib). Registers a "solr9" Search subsystem type that keeps search queries pointed at vanilla Solr 9 (:8983) while routing the Alfresco admin actions (SUMMARY, REPORT, NODEREPORT, ...) to the standalone Alfresco Indexing Trackers service (:8085), which owns that control plane in this fork. Enable with -Dindex.subsystem.name=solr9.
